marketingRemarks.marketingRemark: Welcome to West Seattle! Located on 25th Ave SW, a quiet neighborhood street just steps from Delridge Community Center and its surrounding park and green spaces, this modern townhouse offers an ideal balance of neighborhood living and everyday convenience. Inside, just beyond the beautiful Japanese Maple tree, soaring ceilings and a dramatic wall of windows fill the main living and dining area with natural light, while a separate kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a gas range defines the culinary space. A back entrance leads directly to your designated parking space, making everyday access easy. The elevated second living area continues the home’s bright, open feel and provides an ideal space to work from home or unwind, complemented by a second bedroom with a Murphy bed and a full bathroom. The third floor offers a private primary suite with abundant natural light, along with two closets featuring built-in storage and a bathroom with heated floors, double vanity, and an overhead rainfall shower. Above, two rooftop decks provide room to entertain, relax, or enjoy sweeping neighborhood views, including the downtown Seattle skyline. Fresh interior paint and new carpet complete this move-in-ready, 4-Star Built Green certified home. With West Seattle Golf Course nearby, quick access to the West Seattle Bridge, and no HOA dues, this home offers the convenience of city living in a welcoming residential setting.
